name: NeoLED
description: WS2812/NeoPixel (and SK6812, WS2813/15, clones) driver for ESP32 using the I2S peripheral for reliable timing under load. Multiple parallel strips, multicore-safe, configurable color order, RGBW, brightness, HSV/gamma utilities, C++ and C APIs.
keywords: ws2812, neopixel, sk6812, rgbw, i2s, esp32, addressable-led, led-strip
